For completeness, the Court provides herewith a summary of the procedural posture prior to the 
filing of the TAC. On April 3, 2020, Plaintiff Williams and a former named Plaintiff, Eric Lee, filed 
the initial Complaint in this case. ECF No. 1. On June 8, 2020, Plaintiffs Anderson, Hardin, 
Muhammad, Thiagarajan, and Williams (and other then-named Plaintiffs) filed a motion seeking 
appointment as Lead Plaintiffs in this action. ECF No. 23. The Court granted the motion and 
ordered that Plaintiffs (and other then-named Plaintiffs) be named Lead Plaintiffs in this action. 
ECF No. 40. On September 11, 2020, Plaintiffs (and other then-named Plaintiffs) filed an Amended 
Complaint. ECF No. 43. On December 15, 2020, Plaintiffs (and other then-named Plaintiffs) filed 
a Second Amended Complaint. ECF No. 55. On February 16, 2021, Defendants moved to dismiss 
the Second Amended Complaint and/or to compel arbitration. ECF No. 58. On March 31, 2022, the 
Court granted Defendants’ motion to dismiss without needing to decide Defendants’ prior motion 
to compel arbitration. ECF No. 77. On April 29, 2022, Plaintiffs filed a notice of appeal of the 
Court's grant of the motion to dismiss. ECF No. 79. On March 8, 2024, the Second Circuit reversed 
the Court's dismissal of Plaintiffs’ claims. Williams v. Binance, 96 F.4th 129, 133 (2d Cir. 2024).
